{{Short description|South Korean dancer and musician (born 1984)}} {{family name hatnote|Seo||lang=Korean}} {{BLP sources|date=January 2010}} {{Use mdy dates|date=January 2020}} {{Infobox person | name = Seo In-young | image = Seo In-young at Hera Seoul Fashion Week (1).jpg | caption = Seo at Seoul Fashion Week in 2018 | native_name = 서인영 | birth_name = Seo In-young | alias = Elly | birth_date = {{Birth date and age|1984|9|3}} | occupation = {{hlist|Singer|dancer|actress|model|television host}} | spouse = {{marriage|Unknown|2023|2024|reason=divorce}} | module = {{Infobox musical artist|embed=yes | years_active = 2002–present | genre = {{hlist|[[K-pop]]|[[R&B]]|[[Hip Hop music|Hip Hop]]}} | label = {{flatlist| *[[Star Empire Entertainment|Star Empire]] *IY Company/EB *Playtone *[[Star Empire Entertainment|Star Empire]] *[[Soribada]]{{Cite web |url=http://entertain.naver.com/read?oid=109&aid=0003797251 |title=[공식입장] 소리바다 측 "서인영과 전속계약 체결" |access-date=June 7, 2018 |archive-date=June 8, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220608193457/https://entertain.naver.com/read?oid=109&aid=0003797251 |url-status=live }}}} | past_member_of = [[Jewelry (band)|Jewelry]] | website ={{URL|iycompany.co.kr/}} }} | module2 = {{Infobox Korean name/auto|child=yes|headercolor=transparent |hangul = %서인영 |hanja = 徐寅永 }}}} '''Seo In-young''' ({{Korean|hangul=서인영}}; born September 3, 1984), also known as '''Elly''', is a South Korean singer, dancer, model, television host, and actress. She was a member of girl group [[Jewelry (band)|Jewelry]] and featured on the reality show ''[[We Got Married]]'' with Crown J. In May 2012, Seo established her own private entertainment company, IY Company.{{cite web|url=http://osen.mt.co.kr/article/G1109401943|title='1인 기획사 설립' 서인영, 독자적 행보 걷는다|publisher=[[OSEN (newspaper)|OSEN]]|date=May 18, 2012|access-date=August 20, 2012|archive-date=August 17, 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220817125511/http://osen.mt.co.kr/article/G1109401943|url-status=live}} Seo also hosted the beauty program ''Star Beauty Show'' (2012).{{cite web|title=Seo in Young selected as the main MC for 'Star Beauty Show'|url=http://www.allkpop.com/article/2012/06/seo-in-young-selected-as-the-main-mc-for-star-beauty-show|publisher=[[allkpop]]|access-date=April 6, 2014|archive-date=May 28, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210528100256/http://www.allkpop.com/article/2012/06/seo-in-young-selected-as-the-main-mc-for-star-beauty-show|url-status=live}}{{Unreliable source?|reason=See reliable sources list on [[WP:KO/RS]]|date=June 2025}} ==Career== ===2007: ''Elly Is So Hot''=== [[File:Seo In-Young at SBS Inkigayo in 2007 04.jpg|thumb|upright|Seo promoting her solo debut on ''[[Inkigayo]]'' in February 2007]] On February 26, 2007, Seo In-young released her first solo album, ''[[Elly Is So Hot]]''. Despite being known as the 'sexy dancer' of [[Jewelry (band)|Jewelry]], she stated she wanted to move away from her strong dance image and become a softer, elegant and more sensual entertainer. The first single from the album was "I Want You" ("너를 원해"), which was written, composed, and produced by Jung Yeon-joon of [[Uptown (group)|Uptown]]. The song, which has a mix of Latin and R&B styles, was promoted as a dance remix near the end of her promotional activities. ===2008: ''Elly Is Cinderella''=== [[File:2008 Seo In-Young04.jpg|thumb|upright|Seo at the 2008 [[Style Icon Asia|Style Icon Awards]]]] In February 2008, it was announced that the singer would be participating in the popular [[Munhwa Broadcasting Corporation|MBC]] variety show ''[[We Got Married]]''. She was paired with Korean urban artist Crown J. The couple was later coined as the 'Ant Couple'. The couple later released a digital single titled"Too Much", which was eventually used as the theme song for the show. A club remix version was released on her second solo album. On July 23, 2008, Seo In-young released her second solo album, ''[[Elly Is Cinderella]]''. The music video of the lead single, "Cinderella", was composed by [[Psy (rapper)|PSY]]. The song continued her success as solo artist.{{cite web|url=http://world.kbs.co.kr/english/entertainment/enter_chart_detail.htm?No=7820|title=Seo In-young Returns as Solo|publisher=[[Korean Broadcasting System|KBS World]]|date=July 11, 2008|access-date=July 11, 2008|archive-date=July 17, 2008|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080717043559/http://world.kbs.co.kr/english/entertainment/enter_chart_detail.htm?No=7820|url-status=live}} ===2009: Departure from Jewelry=== [[File:Seo In-young at 2009 SIA (1).jpg|thumb|upright|Seo at the 2009 Style Icon Awards]] On December 11, 2009, it was announced that Seo In-young, as well as fellow [[Jewelry (band)|Jewelry]] member [[Park Jung-ah]], would be leaving the group to fully commit to their solo careers.{{cite web|language=ko|url=http://news.hankooki.com/lpage/culture/200912/h20091211125922111780.htm|script-title=ko:박정아-서인영, 쥬얼리 떠난다 (Park Jung Ah—Seo in Young, Leaving Jewelry).|work=[[Hankook Ilbo]]|date=December 11, 2009|access-date=December 10, 2009|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091214032416/http://news.hankooki.com/lpage/culture/200912/h20091211125922111780.htm|archive-date=December 14, 2009}} Both members left the group after finishing promotional activities for the song ''Sophisticated''. ===2010: ''Lov-Elly'' and ''Ellythm''=== On May 12, 2010, Seo In-young pre-released, "Goodbye Romance", the lead single from her upcoming album.{{cite web|url=http://kpoptoday.com/news/news-seo-in-young-reveals-album-jacket-for-solo-album-lov-elly/|title=Seo in Young reveals album jacket for solo album "Lov-Elly"|work=[[Hankook Ilbo]]|access-date=May 12, 2010|archive-date=February 10, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150210223853/http://kpoptoday.com/news/news-seo-in-young-reveals-album-jacket-for-solo-album-lov-elly/|url-status=live}} On June 6, 2010, her third album, ''Lov-Elly'', was released. (This was her first release since leaving [[Jewelry (band)|Jewelry]].) The album, which consists of all ballads, showed a soft, but powerful side to the singer. "Goodbye Romance" experienced enormous chart success and eventually peaked at No. 1 on the music program ''[[M! Countdown]]'', earning the singer her first solo award. In July 2010, the singer joined the SBS reality show ''[[Heroes (South Korean TV series)|Heroes]]''. She received a lot of negative press for her feisty and headstrong persona. On December 12, 2010, Seo In-young released her first single album, ''Ellythm''. It includes the lead single "Into The Rhythm".{{Cite news|url = http://osen.mt.co.kr/article/G1012070186|script-title=ko:'컴백' 서인영, "오랜만에 댄스곡 컴백 흥분된다"|last = Choi|first = Na Young|date = December 7, 2015|access-date = December 7, 2015|archive-date = March 4, 2016|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20160304084222/http://osen.mt.co.kr/article/G1012070186|url-status = live}} ===2011: ''Wash'' and ''Brand New Elly''=== In early 2011, the Jongno branch of Cheil Industries named Seo In-young as the creative director of their imports division. She worked with French luxury brand 'Nina Ricci' to design a limited edition handbag line named 'Nine Ricci x Seo In-young'. On May 6, 2011, Seo In-young released her second single album ''Wash''. The emotional song showcased her exceptionally powerful vocals. The music video was said to be filmed in Thailand, with a concept of multiple emotions, such as an elegant woman underwater and a sad woman in front of a mirror. [[Star Empire Entertainment]] released a music video teaser and a behind the scenes video, however, no official music video was released. On August 20, 2011, the singer participated in the popular television show ''Immortal Songs 2''. The episode, dubbed 'female vocalist special', showcased seven of South Korea's top female vocalists. Seo In-Young's rendition of ''Just Like The First Time'' won the hearts of viewers and was declared as the best performance of the episode. On October 4, 2011, two comeback photos of the singer were released ahead of her official comeback. In early November, she pre-released the song ''Loser''. On November 13, 2011, the singer officially released her third album, ''Brand New Elly'', with the lead single ''Oh My Gosh''. ===2012: IY Company, "Anymore" and "Let's Dance"=== On May 18, 2012, it was announced that Seo In-young would be establishing her own private entertainment company, IY Company. She is no longer associated or under contract with [[Star Empire Entertainment]]. On August 13, 2012, Seo In-young became the main MC of 'SBS E! – Star Beauty Show'. The show focuses on beauty and fashion tips. On August 13, 2012, a music video teaser for Seo In-young's digital single, "Anymore", was released. It was later revealed the song was produced by popular producer Kush. The single was officially released on August 19, 2012.{{cite web|url=http://news.naver.com/main/read.nhn?mode=LSD&mid=sec&sid1=106&oid=311&aid=0000145001|title=서인영의 홀로서기는 성공할까…첫 싱글 'ANYMORE' 발표|publisher=[[Naver]]|date=August 20, 2012|access-date=August 23, 2012}} The full-length music video was released two days later. The single quickly experienced enormous success, securing the No. 1 spot on every single Korean music chart, achieving the coveted 'all-kill'.{{cite web|url=http://news.nate.com/view/20120821n23911|script-title=ko:'여왕의 귀환' 서인영, 싸이 누르고 신곡 '애니모어' 음원차트 1위|publisher=[[Nate (web portal)|Nate]]|date=August 21, 2012|access-date=August 23, 2012}} On October 15, 2012, Seo In-young revealed a music video teaser for "Let's Dance". The song, which was digitally released on October 17, 2012, is a dance track combining elements of electronic disco as well as post disco, further showing the musical style changes Seo In-young has been going through.{{cite web|url=http://www.tvreport.co.kr/?c=news&m=newsview&idx=272449|script-title=ko:서인영 '렛츠댄스' 오늘(18일) 정오 공개…디스코 열풍 기대|publisher=TVREPORT|date=October 17, 2012|access-date=October 18, 2012|archive-date=November 17, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151117031704/http://www.tvreport.co.kr/?c=news&m=newsview&idx=272449|url-status=live}} On October 18, 2012, Seo In-young took to the stage and began promotions on M! Countdown, where she performed ''ANYMORE'' and ''Let's Dance''.{{cite web|url=http://star.mk.co.kr/new/view.php?mc=ST&no=678970&year=2012|script-title=ko:서인영, '신상녀에게 부는 복고바람'|publisher=STARMK|date=October 18, 2012|access-date=October 18, 2012|archive-date=February 10, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150210233405/http://star.mk.co.kr/new/view.php?mc=ST&no=678970&year=2012|url-status=live}} ===2013: ''Forever Young'' and "Love Me"=== In early 2013, Seo In-young became a main voice coach for ''Voice Korea Kids'', a spin-off of ''[[The Voice of Korea]]''. The show aired from January 4, 2013, to February 1, 2013. On May 2, 2013, Seo In-young announced that she would be making her first comeback of the year with the release of concept photos and a music video teaser. Her company, IY Company, stated, "With her talents, this will be an album that showcases her new potential."{{cite web|url=http://starin.edaily.co.kr/news/NewsRead.edy?SCD=EA21&newsid=01161126602804984&DCD=A10202|script-title=ko:서인영도 컴백..5월 대전 가세|publisher=StarIn|date=May 15, 2013|access-date=May 15, 2013|archive-date=October 5, 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131005015349/http://starin.edaily.co.kr/news/NewsRead.edy?SCD=EA21&newsid=01161126602804984&DCD=A10202|url-status=live}} On May 14, 2013, Seo In-young released her first mini-album in two years, titled ''Forever Young''. The album is considered Seo In-young's return to ballads and contains the promotional single "Let's Break Up."{{cite web|url=http://xportsnews.hankyung.com/?ac=article_view&entry_id=327036|title=서인영 '헤어지자', 여자의 덤덤한 이별 예감… '변신 성공'|publisher=[[Nate (web portal)|Nate]]|date=May 15, 2013|access-date=May 15, 2013|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131005013148/http://xportsnews.hankyung.com/?ac=article_view&entry_id=327036|archive-date=October 5, 2013}} On September 23, 2013, it was announced that Seo In-young would be returning to the music scene with a digital single titled "Love Me". According to Seo In-young, the song is "an upbeat dance track through which she puts aside her previous ballad concept".{{cite web|url=http://news.sportsseoul.com/read/entertain/1242457.htm|script-title=ko:서인영 다이나믹 듀오 개코와 손잡고 댄싱퀸의 귀환알려|publisher=[[Sports Seoul]]|date=September 23, 2013|access-date=October 4, 2013|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131005030816/http://news.sportsseoul.com/read/entertain/1242457.htm|archive-date=October 5, 2013}} On October 3, 2013, Seo In-young debuted her new song, "Love Me", through a pre-release performance on [[Mnet (TV channel)|Mnet]]'s ''M! Countdown''.{{cite web|url=http://sports.chosun.com/news/ntype.htm?id=201310030100040510002459&servicedate=20131003|script-title=ko:서인영, '나를 사랑해줘!'|publisher=[[Sports Chosun]]|date=October 3,
